provenance: SIMULATED: derived from a sim run (sim/trolley.py), not recorded by real trolleys

mapping.put_back: scan_in then scan_out (the put-back EPOS never sees)

pass_s_per_shelf_row.note: assumption: seconds to roll past one shelf row of a bay without stopping

look_s.value: event notice_factors.seconds_at_shelf (persona param; 6 s if missing)
look_s.note: sim value: each product the shopper looked at adds the persona's seconds_at_shelf to the bay dwell

pickup_s.note: assumption: extra seconds to pick up and handle a product (read the pack)

walk_m_same_aisle.note: assumption: metres between neighbouring bays in one aisle

walk_m_new_aisle.note: assumption: metres to the next aisle (round the end cap)

dwell_min_s.note: assumption: a trolley stopped >= 5 s at a bay counts as a dwell (spec: 'at least N seconds')

trip_start.note: assumption: arrival time of day; real trolleys log real clocks

opt_in_loyalty.note: assumption (configurable): share of trips that scan a loyalty card / app at the till; not measured

household.value: opted-in shoppers of the same persona in one run, up to 3 trips per loyalty_id, 7 days apart
household.note: simulation shortcut so a loyalty_id has repeat visits to count; in a store the loyalty card makes this link

put_back_capture.note: assumption: every sim put-back is caught as a scan_out (cart camera / weight drop). With scan-only handsets an item put back without being scanned would be missed: upper bound

not_recorded: which product at a bay was looked at
anything about health (only declared at checkout, never inferred)
privacy: trolley_id random per trip; loyalty_id (pseudonymous hash) only when opt_in_loyalty is true; no persona, traits or health data in a session
